title: Gene Dosage Experiments in Enterobacteriaceae Using Arabinose-regulated Promoters
author: Sanchari Bhattacharyya
license_note: PMC full-text XML — Bio-protocol — CC-BY confirmed in article XML

steps.title: Transform plasmid into cells
steps.instruction: Electroporate the pBAD/MCS plasmid carrying the gene of interest into electro‑competent E. coli BW27783 cells and immediately spread the mixture on LB‑agar plates containing 100 µg ml⁻¹ ampicillin.

steps.title: Incubate transformants
steps.instruction: Incubate the plated cells overnight (≈16 h) at 37 °C.

steps.title: Inoculate overnight culture
steps.instruction: Pick a single colony and inoculate it into 2 ml supplemented M9 medium (see Recipe) containing 100 µg ml⁻¹ ampicillin; grow overnight at 37 °C with shaking at 250 rpm in a 14 ml polypropylene tube.

steps.title: Dilute into fresh medium
steps.instruction: Dilute 500 µl of the overnight culture 1:100 into 50 ml fresh supplemented M9 medium (in a 50 ml tube) containing 100 µg ml⁻¹ ampicillin and the desired L‑(+) arabinose concentrations (0 % to 0.05 % w/v); incubate 4 h at 37 °C, 250 rpm.

steps.title: Harvest cells
steps.instruction: Measure OD₆₀₀ of each culture, then centrifuge the 50 ml cultures in a tabletop centrifuge at 3 000 × g for 15 min; aspirate as much supernatant as possible and store the cell pellets at –20 °C (use 1.5 ml microfuge tubes if convenient).

steps.title: Prepare lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Make a buffer of 50 mM sodium phosphate (pH 7.4) and 10 mM Tris‑HCl (pH 8.0); to 10 ml of this buffer add 1 ml 10× Bugbuster reagent and 10 µl Benzonase nuclease (see Lysis buffer recipe).

steps.title: Resuspend pellets for lysis
steps.instruction: Based on the measured OD₆₀₀, resuspend each frozen pellet in the prepared lysis buffer so that the final suspension has an OD₆₀₀ of 2.0.

steps.title: Lyse cells
steps.instruction: Incubate the resuspended cells on a rotator‑mixer for 20 min at room temperature to allow complete lysis.

steps.title: Clarify lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysates for 30 min at 7 500 × g in a pre‑chilled (4 °C) centrifuge; collect the clear supernatant for downstream analysis.

steps.title: Quantify protein
steps.instruction: Determine total protein concentration of each supernatant using the Pierce BCA protein assay kit, following the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Prepare SDS‑PAGE samples
steps.instruction: Dilute the supernatants as required, mix with 4× protein gel loading dye, and load 20 µl of each sample onto a pre‑cast 12 % Bis‑Tris SDS polyacrylamide gel.

steps.title: Run electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Run the gel at a voltage gradient of 10 V cm⁻¹ until the dye front reaches the bottom of the gel.

steps.title: Transfer proteins
steps.instruction: Transfer the resolved proteins to a nitrocellulose membrane using pre‑assembled Trans‑Blot Turbo midi nitrocellulose transfer packs; after transfer, wash the membrane twice with distilled water.

steps.title: Immunodetect target
steps.instruction: Develop the membrane with the Western‑breeze Chromogenic Immunodetection kit (anti‑rabbit) according to the kit protocol to visualize the protein of interest.

steps.title: Prepare growth‑rate cultures
steps.instruction: Dilute the overnight culture to an OD₆₀₀ of 0.01 in fresh supplemented M9 medium containing 100 µg ml⁻¹ ampicillin and the same arabinose concentrations as above.

steps.title: Set up Bioscreen plate
steps.instruction: Aliquot 150 µl of each diluted culture into three wells of a Bioscreen honeycomb plate (technical replicates); repeat for three independent colonies (biological replicates). Add 150 µl of M9 medium without cells to three separate wells as blanks.

steps.title: Measure growth kinetics
steps.instruction: Place the plate in a Bioscreen C instrument set to 37 °C with shaking; record OD₆₀₀ every 15 min for 12 h.

steps.title: Prepare supplemented M9 medium
steps.instruction: For 1 L, dissolve 11.28 g M9 salts, add 1 ml 1 M MgSO₄, 5 µl 100 mM thiamine, 10 ml 10 % casamino acid, and 10 ml 20 % glucose; bring the volume to 1 L with distilled water and filter‑sterilize.

steps.title: Prepare lysis buffer stock
steps.instruction: Combine 1 ml 10× Bugbuster reagent and 10 µl Benzonase nuclease with the chosen buffer (50 mM sodium phosphate pH 7.4, 10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0) and adjust the final volume to 10 ml.

steps.title: Make arabinose series
steps.instruction: Start with a 0.05 % (w/v) L‑(+) arabinose solution and perform 4‑fold serial dilutions down to 1.22 × 10⁻⁵ % (w/v); include a 0 % arabinose control.
